text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are trained on. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups, so fairness must always be considered. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies and governments need to protect people's data. Transparency is also essential, because users should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means creating technology that benefits everyone and respects human rights.
